notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.
